primary_unit: One preregistered physical map, up to 6 distinct tickets; unavailable roots are retained in the source registration; each has one continuation draw per alternative. No fitting or swapping roots on the basis of scores or outcomes.
predict_before_reading_suffix: Use only frozen weights, the locked 6-map manifest, each actual root public players / seat / step, two commands, same-depth native values and metadata. Publish one immutable file that binds every root. No branch labels or future observations read by this script.
interpretation: Standalone rr_scores A/B predicts return of currently carried own cargo on the same collector within the next 12 moves, bounded by its current load. Can be compared descriptively to later total own deposits, and net deposits as a secondary proxy, but newly earned cargo, rival delivery and cross-carrier transfers may differ. Differences of native values plus scale times A minus B cash estimate specify the predicted terminal ranking. These are separate predictions; label sign tie or frozen prediction tie remain separately visible.
admissible: t279 or t285, each alternative H=8, 1 rollout, not interrupted and native top-two only; otherwise diagnostic extrapolation. Unknown original metadata is uncertified. Native tiebreak preserves original A. Predict joint score once per root, not at each leaf. Still no development qualification.
direction_convention: A minus B, >0 favors A, <0 favors B, exact zero ties. Signed model+native chooses B only strictly above A, preserving A on a tie. Independent test of any positive value shift; no confidence threshold tuned after observing results. Report unaltered and changed roots, including errors and official margin, and never extrapolate sparse paired realized margins to whole-game win rate.
